title: +*SUSTAINABILITY FOR THE COMMON GOOD
description: Examines human relationships to Earth’s systems with an emphasis on what we might do, collectively and individually, so that our natural environment, our economies, and our societies can thrive in the future. Applies interdisciplinary and teamwork approaches to producing and communicating possible solutions to today’s sustainability challenges.
registration_restrictions: Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.
